new_task_1.title: Expose the CycloneDX SBOM helper from the `conan.tools.sbom` package
new_task_1.description: Conan 2.12.2 adds a package-level re-export so `cyclonedx_1_4` can be imported directly from `conan.tools.sbom` instead of only through the deeper `conan.tools.sbom.cyclonedx` module path.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Make the experimental CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM helper available from the top-level `conan.tools.sbom` package so users can import it through the package entry point.

expectation.grounded: The `conan.tools.sbom` package should re-export `cyclonedx_1_4` from `conan.tools.sbom.cyclonedx`, allowing callers to import the helper with `from conan.tools.sbom import cyclonedx_1_4`.
expectation.conceptual: Users of the SBOM tooling should have a stable, discoverable package-level import path for the CycloneDX helper without needing to know the internal module layout.

constraints.grounded: This change should expose the existing `cyclonedx_1_4` helper through an additional public import path without changing the helper's underlying behavior or requiring callers to import from the nested `cyclonedx` module.
constraints.conceptual: The update should improve API ergonomics and discoverability while preserving compatibility with the existing implementation.

behavior: Callers can import the helper directly with `from conan.tools.sbom import cyclonedx_1_4`.
The nested module path remains the implementation source for the re-exported helper.
acceptance_criteria: Importing `cyclonedx_1_4` from `conan.tools.sbom` should succeed without requiring callers to reference `conan.tools.sbom.cyclonedx` explicitly.
The object imported from `conan.tools.sbom` should expose the same CycloneDX 1.4 SBOM helper functionality as the nested module export.
